subject: Re: SIG/Control Evidence plan and delivery timeline for Gamma Enterprise
messages:
From: Samantha Green <sam.green@gammaenterprise.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Gamma Enterprise Procurement <procurement@gammaenterprise.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire + evidence request (initial)

Neha,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As discussed, we're running a parallel SIG (SIG Lite) review ahead of our procurement committee next month. To keep things moving we need: 1) a completed SIG assessment (high level) mapping to Redwood's SOC 2 and ISO-27001 artifacts, 2) a short evidence index (artifact name, control mapped, access instructions), and 3) screenshots or config proof for KMS/HSM usage and retention settings.

Can you provide a delivery plan and expected dates? We aim to complete our internal review by Nov 12. Also please let me know if you need a mutual action plan (MAP) template from our side.

Thanks,
Samantha Green
Director, Security Risk Management
Gamma Enterprise

Attachment: Gamma_SIG_Request_v1.pdf (1 page)
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <sam.green@gammaenterprise.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + evidence request (initial)

Samantha —

Appreciate the clear ask and timeline. We can meet your Nov 12 review target. Proposed plan:

- By Nov 3: deliver a completed SIG-lite PDF and an evidence index CSV (artifact name, owner, control refs, access instructions).
- By Nov 5: deliver SOC 2 control mapping spreadsheet and KMS/HSM config screenshots.
- Nov 6–10: address follow-ups / redlines; final tranche by Nov 11.

Marissa will lead the control mapping and attach the artifacts. Karthik will validate the KMS/HSM screenshots and retention policy snippets. I'll own communications and the MAP if you want one.

Two quick Qs: 1) Do you need ISO-27001 clause-level mapping or just SOC 2 control IDs? 2) Are there any additional delivery constraints for the artifacts (e.g., IP allowlist, limited-time access)?

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: redwood_intake_log.txt (internal note)
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <sam.green@gammaenterprise.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + evidence request (initial)

Hi Samantha / team —

I've attached the initial deliverables to this thread: the completed SIG_Assessment_Complete.pdf and an evidence-index.csv with links and short access notes. The redwood-soc2-control-map.xlsx contains a tab for SOC 2 mapping and another tab with an ISO-27001 clause crosswalk (we included clause-level references as you asked).

Notes on a few items:
- KMS/HSM: included kms-config-screenshot.png and a short export of our key rotation metadata. Karthik validated with cloud infra that the KMS is customer-key-compatible and that rotation is every 90 days for the master key.
- Data retention: evidence-index.csv has links to our retention policy excerpt and mappings to retention controls.
- Access: Drive links are shared with your security group; if you need IP restrictions we can provide temporary signed URLs or S3 presigned objects instead.

Delivery summary: please review the attached and flag controls where you want deeper artifacts (e.g., configuration files or anonymized logs). We can schedule a 30-min follow-up demo/pass-through if helpful.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIG_Assessment_Complete.pdf; evidence-index.csv; redwood-soc2-control-map.xlsx; kms-config-screenshot.png

Team —

Thanks — we received the packet and the Drive links. The procurement committee asked for a short mutual action plan (MAP) so they can attach dates to procurement milestones; can you produce a 1-page MAP with owners and target dates (delivery of artifacts, Q/A window, legal review)? If possible, please include a DocuSign link we can use for an addendum to the SOW (low-risk, temporary access clause).

Also, we flagged three controls for deeper dives (SOC2 CC6.1, ISO A.9.2.3, SIG 3.4.1) — can you confirm you'll provide the supporting anonymized logs and configuration snippets for those by Nov 10?

If Nov 10 is tight, propose the earliest date and we'll adjust our review schedule.

Best regards,
Samantha Green
Director, Security Risk Management
Gamma Enterprise
